claim_one_line: THE APEX INDEX RULE (after B1502 section 5; the owner's go): at a G2 cone point over a finite quotient of a compact nearly Kaehler manifold, for every automorphism gamma of finite order of the SU(3)-structure, sum over isolated fixed points of prod_j (1 - e^{-i theta_j})^{-1} + sum over fixed J-holomorphic curves of (i/8) cot(theta/2) sin^{-2}(theta/2) (d_1 - d_2) = 0 (theta_j the J-angles of d gamma; e^{+-i theta} the normal eigenvalues of a curve, d_1, d_2 the degrees of its normal J-eigenlines), because the link is spin with positive scalar curvature (Lichnerowicz: the Dirac index vanishes for every lift) and Atiyah-Singer's Lefschetz formula in Todd form gives these terms (the chi(C) terms cancel since c_1 = 0). Each curve enters through Witten's cubic inflow n = (N/2)(d_1 - d_2) (N the transverse order). Consequences: (C1) a lone locus forces nothing, on every finite quotient of a smooth compact nearly Kaehler manifold (not beyond: Witten's cone over WCP^3_{N,N,1,1}, whose link is not such a quotient, has a lone SU(N) locus with n = 1 -- C4, section 6); (C2) a cusp point is chiral through the cubic half only where its locus meets another locus or isolated fixed point of the same symmetry (else only the mixed half, needing [F] != 0 and a C-field U(1)); (C3) order two gives no condition. Run as sealed (seal af568744, sha256 d4260750..., instrument fafbf975) on B1501's 694 classes: components identical to the census on all 694; the rule holds on all 306 with fixed points (worst |S| 1.2e-13); 222 fixed spheres with integral degrees, isotropy weights = lattice Chern numbers on both grids; 9 curves with normal angle pi. Decided at design time and confirmed: D1 S^6's single spheres Delta = 0; D2 the 25 torus classes n = 0 (B1502 re-derived without homogeneity); D3 S^3 x S^3's 3-symmetry: the point e Delta with angles (2pi/3)^3, term -i/(3 sqrt 3), and a sphere (0, -2), an SU(3) locus with n = 3 (sigma^2: -3) balanced by the isolated point. Sealed predictions all YES: P1 CP^3's 22 two-sphere classes of order >= 3 pair at one angle with n = +-N, N = 3..12 (~65%); P2 CP^3's 22 one-sphere classes n = 0, the points cancelling (~75%); P3 F_{1,2}'s 132 spheres n = 0 (~80%); P4 forced inflow only on CP^3 (22 classes, largest |n| 12) and S^3 x S^3 (sigma, sigma^2; the only classes balancing a curve against points); none on S^6, F_{1,2} or any torus. Not settled: what the 3-symmetry's isolated point carries physically; links outside the census (Foscolo-Haskins' S^6 carries the linear SU(2) x SU(2) action of the round S^6, whose elements fix only spheres, so it gives no torus locus -- section 6 withdrew the pointer; their S^3 x S^3, extra discrete automorphisms and orbifold links that are not global quotients remain); torsion. Standard ingredients (Atiyah-Singer, Lichnerowicz, Witten, Acharya-Witten, Fukui-Hatsugai-Suzuki); no novelty claimed. No physics crossed. 0 of 19.
